output.name: Varosk

anatomy.part: nose tip, end of the long snout
jaw corner, where the snout meets the throat
withers, on the back above the forelegs
hind paw, the foot pushing off the ebb
rump, the top of the haunch

output.myth: When Aun cut the string he was in a hurry, and he left his hound on the shore below the cliffs. Varosk was grey, and his teeth rang like bells when he shook his head. One season he ran the ebb, nose down in the wet weed, hunting his master's smell. When the tide turned he barked at every boat that came in late, so crews learned to row hard. Hesk kept count of the boats he turned home. Tavo tried once to blow him off the rocks, but Varosk only shook his coat and ran on. Kael casts for him and has never got him in the net. The old women say that if you hear bells under the water after dark, you should row fast and call your own name, so the hound knows you are not Aun. He is up in the Leeward Reach, a grey lamp with his nose to the wind, waiting for a boat that is late.
output.verse:
Bells under the tide,
the grey hound runs the ebb still,
row fast, say your name.
